invariants: No source version is overwritten or reviewed automatically.
Failed batches do not advance cursors or commit partial source imports.
HTTP 429 cooldown is persisted across provider jobs.
No search snippet, paid PACER fetch, model call, expert annotation or legal certification.
limitations: Real provider access is untested without credentials.
Provider quotas and incomplete holdings limit backfill speed and coverage.
Permanent malformed/oversized records block their job rather than being silently skipped.
Periodic reconciliation seeks old/backdated changes; recent-window queries alone cannot cover them.
Liveness does not establish acquisition freshness; consult authenticated status.
live_activation_required: Deploy importer with PostgreSQL and migration 0004
